meta.title: Top 30 tech employers for senior/staff software engineers in Germany by realistic total comp
meta.compBasis: estimated annual senior/staff total compensation (base + bonus + equity)
sources: live ATS board URLs where verifiable
meta.caveats: Trading firms and VSOP-heavy scale-ups skew higher in realized comp than levels.fyi all-levels medians and are thinly sampled; treat their figures as wide ranges. Only Celonis (greenhouse) was directly confirmed via a live board URL. Big-tech firms often run bespoke/Workday portals, so 'other' slugs are informational. Verify each slug at job-boards.greenhouse.io/{slug} or jobs.lever.co/{slug} before relying on it.

companies.name: Jane Street
companies.reason: Quant trading firm where senior-engineer cash comp (mostly bonus) dwarfs standard tech equity packages.

companies.name: Meta Platforms
companies.reason: Tops the levels.fyi Germany leaderboard on the strength of large RSU grants at senior (E5) level.

companies.name: Optiver
companies.reason: Market-maker whose senior SWE packages are bonus-heavy and reach EUR 250K-360K at the Amsterdam hub.

companies.name: IMC Trading
companies.reason: Prop-trading firm with an Amsterdam engineering hub and cash bonuses well above SaaS norms.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.reason: Data-cloud leader paying near the top of the Germany leaderboard via heavy RSU loading.

companies.name: Nutanix
companies.reason: Enterprise-cloud firm near the top of the Germany leaderboard for senior engineers.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.reason: AI-hardware boom has pushed senior (IC4) packages to the top tier, with German R&D sites.
